name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2018 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2018 record supports: Talos on Olympic Destroyer and VPNFilter, US-CERT TA18-074A, TA18-106A, TA18-149A, TA18-201A, TA18-275A and TA18-276B, CISA AA18-284A and AA18-337A, the 2018 GRU, Mabna, Park Jin Hyok, SamSam and APT10 indictments, the GitHub memcached report, Ticketmaster, event-stream and other victim statements, and the ATT&CK objects G0035 Dragonfly, G0034 Sandworm Team, G0007 APT28, G0122 Silent Librarian, G0045 menuPass, G0082 APT38, S0365 Olympic Destroyer, S1010 VPNFilter, S0367 Emotet, S0370 SamSam and campaign C0021. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2018.md. Scores: 100 the source or ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
